svg.title: Binary Lights · physical wiring layout
svg.desc: Illustrated Arduino Uno, breadboard, twelve LEDs and resistors, and infrared receiver. Pin connections are detailed in the accessible table below.
svg.text: Twelve LEDs with individual 1 kΩ resistors • infrared receiver on D11
USB-powered Arduino Uno · pin names match the sketch
Receiver: follow S / + / − labels, not package position. Layout is illustrative; use the pin table for assembly.
